description: Generic error returned to the user when a /playbook slash command fails to execute for any reason.
Markdown section heading in the to-do digest the Playbooks bot sends via DM (and in the /playbook todo response); introduces the list of runs with overdue status updates.

translation.one: You have {{.Count}} run overdue for a status update:
translation.other: You have {{.Count}} runs overdue for a status update:

description: Line in the bot DM digest under the overdue status updates heading, preceding a list of run links; {{.Count}} is the number of runs the user owns that are overdue for a status update. 'Run' is a noun (execution of a playbook).
Line in the bot DM digest under the overdue status updates heading when the user has no runs overdue for a status update.
Markdown section heading in the bot DM to-do digest; introduces the list of the user's in-progress runs. 'Runs' is a noun (executions of a playbook).

translation.one: You have {{.Count}} run currently in progress:
translation.other: You have {{.Count}} runs currently in progress:

description: Line in the bot DM digest under the runs-in-progress heading, preceding a list of run links; {{.Count}} is the number of runs the user participates in. 'Run' is a noun.

translation: You have 0 runs currently in progress.
description: Line in the bot DM digest under the runs-in-progress heading when the user participates in no active runs.

translation: Please use `/playbook todo` to see all your tasks.
description: Hint appended to the daily digest DM when some assigned tasks are due later; markdown with a literal slash command in backticks that must not be translated.

translation.one: You have **{{.Count}} assigned task due after today**.
translation.other: You have **{{.Count}} assigned tasks due after today**.

description: Summary line in the daily digest DM; {{.Count}} is the number of the user's assigned tasks whose due date is in the future; markdown bold. Followed in the same paragraph by the hint to use /playbook todo.
Compact due-date badge appended after a task name in the digest task list; {{.Count}} is the number of days until the task is due; rendered in monospace.
Compact due-date badge appended after a task name in the digest task list, for tasks due on the current day; rendered in bold monospace.

Compact overdue badge appended after a task name in the digest task list; {{.Count}} is the number of days past the due date (always 2 or more; 'yesterday' has its own string); rendered in bold monospace.
Compact overdue badge appended after a task name in the digest task list, for tasks whose due date was the previous day; rendered in bold monospace.
Markdown section heading in the bot DM to-do digest; introduces the list of checklist tasks assigned to the user across runs.
Line in the full to-do digest (/playbook todo) preceding the list of the user's assigned tasks; {{.Count}} is the total number of assigned tasks; ends with a colon.

translation.one: You have {{.Count}} assigned task that is now due:
translation.other: You have {{.Count}} assigned tasks that are now due:

description: Line in the daily digest DM preceding the task list; {{.Count}} is the number of the user's assigned tasks that are due today or overdue; ends with a colon.
Line in the bot DM digest under the assigned-tasks heading when the user has no assigned tasks.
Introduction text of the 'Run playbook' interactive dialog; {{.Username}} is the display name of the user who will own the new run; markdown bold on 'Owner'.
Label of the playbook select field in the 'Run playbook' dialog, where the user picks which playbook (process template) to start.
Label of the text field in the 'Run playbook' dialog where the user names the new run; 'run' is a noun (execution of a playbook).
Submit button of the 'Run playbook' dialog; starts the new run; 'run' is a noun; compact button label.
Title of the interactive dialog for starting a playbook; 'Run' is a verb here (execute the playbook).
Label of the optional description textarea in the 'Add new task' dialog for a run's checklist.
Label of the task name text field in the 'Add new task' dialog for a run's checklist.
Submit button of the 'Add new task' dialog; adds the task to the run's checklist; compact button label.
Title of the interactive dialog for adding a checklist task to a run.
Label of the select field in the 'Add to run timeline' dialog where the user picks which run's timeline the post should be added to; noun phrase.
Submit button of the dialog that saves a channel post as an event on a run's timeline; 'run timeline' means the chronological event log of the run.
Label of the short text field in the 'Add to run timeline' dialog where the user writes a summary of the timeline event; noun.
Help text under the summary field in the 'Add to run timeline' dialog stating the 64-character limit; very compact.

translation: Short summary shown in the timeline
description: Placeholder text of the summary field in the 'Add to run timeline' dialog; 'timeline' is the run's chronological event log.
Title of the interactive dialog for saving a channel post as an event on a run's timeline.

translation.one: There is **{{.Count}} outstanding task**. Are you sure you want to finish *{{.RunName}}* for all participants?
translation.other: There are **{{.Count}} outstanding tasks**. Are you sure you want to finish *{{.RunName}}* for all participants?

description: Introduction text of the 'Confirm finish' dialog shown before finishing a run that still has unchecked tasks; {{.Count}} is the number of incomplete tasks, {{.RunName}} is the run's name; markdown bold and italics.
Submit button of the 'Confirm finish' dialog; confirms ending the run; verb, compact button label.
Title of the confirmation dialog shown before finishing a run that has outstanding tasks; 'finish' is a noun/gerund here (the act of finishing the run).

translation: @{{.Name}} is a run participant and wants join this channel. Any member of the channel can invite them.
description: Bot post in the run's channel when a run participant asks to be added to it; {{.Name}} is the requester's username rendered as an @-mention; keep the leading @ and trailing newline.

Bot post in the run's channel when someone requests a status update; keep the literal @here mention; {{.Name}} is the requester's username (@-mentioned), {{.RunName}}/{{.RunURL}} form a markdown link to the run.
Bot post in the run's channel announcing that a user turned off periodic status update reminders; {{.Username}} is @-mentioned, {{.RunName}}/{{.RunURL}} form a markdown link to the run.
Bot post in the run's channel announcing that a user turned on periodic status update reminders; {{.Username}} is @-mentioned, {{.RunName}}/{{.RunURL}} form a markdown link to the run.
Label of the main textarea in the 'Status update' dialog where the user writes what changed in the run since the previous update.
Label of an optional checkbox in the 'Status update' dialog that also ends the run when the update is posted; 'run' is a noun; compact label.

translation: Also mark the run as finished
description: Placeholder/description text next to the 'Finish run' checkbox in the 'Status update' dialog, clarifying that checking it also marks the run as finished.

translation.one: Provide an update to the stakeholders. This post will be broadcasted to {{.Count}} channel.
translation.other: Provide an update to the stakeholders. This post will be broadcasted to {{.Count}} channels.

description: Introduction text of the 'Status update' dialog; {{.Count}} is the number of channels the update post will be broadcast to.
Label of the select field in the 'Status update' dialog for choosing when to be reminded to post the next update (options like 15min, 60min).
Submit button of the 'Status update' dialog; 'Post' is a verb (publishes the update as a message); compact button label.
Title of the interactive dialog for posting a status update on a run; noun phrase.

translation: shown because the task was modified
description: Reason label attached to a checklist task in a run, explaining why a conditionally-hidden task is still visible (its assignee or state was changed); lowercase sentence fragment.
